examples.text: On this day they didn't work, but met for trade and religious festivals.
examples.translation: 这一天，他们不工作，而是聚在一起交易、庆祝宗教节日。
examples.speechText: On this day they didn't work, but met for trade and religious festivals.

examples.text: The best collectors survived long cold winters or seasons without rain.
examples.translation: 最善于采集的人熬过了漫长寒冷的冬季或没有雨水的季节。
examples.speechText: The best collectors survived long cold winters or seasons without rain.

examples.text: Today's grandparents are joining（join的-ing形式） their grandchildren on social media.
examples.translation: 如今，祖父母也开始和孙辈一起使用社交媒体。
examples.speechText: Today's grandparents are joining their grandchildren on social media.

examples.text: Scientists first began to hear and study the complex songs（song的复数形式） of the humpback whales in the 1970s.
examples.translation: 科学家最早在二十世纪七十年代开始听到并研究座头鲸复杂的歌声。
examples.speechText: Scientists first began to hear and study the complex songs of the humpback whales in the 1970s.

examples.text: Though normally I can walk for miles without taking any rest, I found today’s walk to the zoo very tiring.
examples.translation: 虽然平时我走几英里都不用休息，但今天走去动物园却让我觉得很累。
examples.speechText: Though normally I can walk for miles without taking any rest, I found today’s walk to the zoo very tiring.

examples.text: When we taste traditional food, we can also learn about the stories behind it.
examples.translation: 品尝传统食物时，我们也能了解食物背后的故事。
examples.speechText: When we taste traditional food, we can also learn about the stories behind it.

examples.text: Others question whether it is right to “Play God” in an attempt to eliminate diseases of this world.
examples.translation: 另一些人则质疑，为了消除世上的疾病而试图“扮演上帝”，是否正确。
examples.speechText: Others question whether it is right to “Play God” in an attempt to eliminate diseases of this world.

examples.text: However, she stressed that people do not need to be so rigid that they can no longer sleep at all if they have to break from their routine to work late or deal with a restless child.
examples.translation: 然而，她强调，人们不必把作息安排得过于死板，以至于因加班或照顾不安分的孩子而不得不打破规律时，就完全无法入睡。
examples.speechText: However, she stressed that people do not need to be so rigid that they can no longer sleep at all if they have to break from their routine to work late or deal with a restless child.

examples.text: So whether the weather is good or bad, we need to keep exercising.
examples.translation: 所以，不论天气好坏，我们都需要坚持锻炼。
examples.speechText: So whether the weather is good or bad, we need to keep exercising.

examples.text: Harris also noted that it is essential to remember that humans were able to sleep peacefully well before the invention of drugs（drug的复数形式） and technology.
examples.translation: Harris还指出，务必要记住：早在药物和技术被发明之前，人类就能够安稳入睡。
examples.speechText: Harris also noted that it is essential to remember that humans were able to sleep peacefully well before the invention of drugs and technology.

examples.text: Some scientists want to apply the methods used in cloning animals to produce skin, organs（organ的复数形式） and other body parts for humans.
examples.translation: 一些科学家希望把克隆动物所用的方法，应用于为人类培育皮肤、器官及其他身体部位。
examples.speechText: Some scientists want to apply the methods used in cloning animals to produce skin, organs and other body parts for humans.

examples.text: Not all types of freedom are the same in terms（term的复数形式） of happiness, however.
examples.translation: 然而，从幸福的角度来看，并非所有类型的自由都相同。
examples.speechText: Not all types of freedom are the same in terms of happiness, however.

examples.text: He says automated cameras can help fill that blank.
examples.translation: 他说，自动摄像头能够帮助填补这一空缺。
examples.speechText: He says automated cameras can help fill that blank.

examples.text: Eventually, you will forget the reason for your anger.
examples.translation: 最终，你会忘记自己生气的原因。
examples.speechText: Eventually, you will forget the reason for your anger.

examples.text: Don’t worry, this is a mental habit that you can definitely break.
examples.translation: 别担心，这只是一种心理习惯，你完全可以改掉。
examples.speechText: Don’t worry, this is a mental habit that you can definitely break.
